modules.retirement_condition: The API lifespan owns a typed Arq enqueue client and tests no longer inject module globals.
Billing cache ownership moves entirely to FastAPI application state.
Runtime settings cache is provided by an application-scoped cache service.
Proxy pool is constructed and closed by application lifespan composition.
Redis client ownership moves to application state and dependency injection.
The context summary adapter registry moves to an application-owned conversation composition object.
The process upload budget is constructed by the image upload composition root and injected into upload commands.
The tracker is constructed by TgBot startup and injected into handlers and listeners.
Worker startup constructs and closes the provider pool runtime explicitly.
Worker startup owns billing cache refresh state.
Auto-title cache is owned by a task application runtime.
Token counting runtime is constructed by an explicit process composition owner instead of package import.
Provider proxy tunnel runtime is constructed and closed by each application composition root.
Video transcode loop capacity is injected by the application media composition root.
